summary: AH Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the first closing of its Multifamily Disposition, selling 9 of 11 multifamily properties for ~$485M in aggregate proceeds under a $562M purchase agreement with an unrelated third party. The remaining two properties are expected to close by end-2026 and mid-2027. No board recommendation or advisor is named in this filing. The transaction reduces the company's multifamily exposure and generates significant cash. Watch for completion of the remaining sales and use of proceeds.
